title: European Partnerships: Horizon Europe Funding for Joint Undertakings Must Focus on Research
what_changed: Responding to the design of European Partnerships under FP10, EUA calls for EOSC to remain a distinct partnership with its own work programme. It characterises EOSC as a collectively funded, community-owned research commons connecting distributed resources while preserving national and institutional ownership.
why_it_matters: Following the LIBER position, this shows convergence between libraries and universities around a specific post-2027 governance model. It also places Open Science infrastructure inside the broader contest over whether FP10 funding should prioritise open collaborative research or industrial deployment.
